The house

An event is remembered for how it made people feel.

Sandi Events is the event design house of Kyriaki Kalou. We create corporate events, brand launches and private celebrations for companies and people who expect much more than a well-run evening: a clear idea, flawless aesthetics and an organisation that nobody notices — because everything simply works.

Every event starts from a conversation: who you are, who your guests are and what they should take home. Then we take on everything — the concept and the design, the venue, the suppliers, the timing and the coordination on the day — with one person responsible from the first call to the last guest leaving.

  1. 01

    Design

    Concept, mood board, colour palette, floral design, set design, stationery — one coherent aesthetic, in your style.

  2. 02

    Production

    Venue scouting, catering, sound & light, staging, transport, accommodation — negotiated and managed for you.

  3. 03

    Coordination

    Minute-by-minute run sheet, guest management and on-site direction, so that the day runs exactly as planned.

Corporate events that speak for your company.

Your company's event is a statement to your people, your clients and your partners. We design it with the discretion, punctuality and precision that a corporate brief demands — and with an aesthetic that makes it memorable.

    Weddings

    Your wedding, the way you imagined it — without the stress.

    We plan weddings in Athens, on the islands and anywhere in Greece — for couples who live here and for couples who come from abroad to marry under the Greek sky. You decide how involved you want to be; we make sure every decision is easy and every detail is in place.

    Full planning

    From the first idea to the last dance: venue, design, suppliers, budget, guests, timeline and coordination.

    Partial planning

    You already have the basics; we complete the picture with design, the right suppliers and a clear plan.

    Coordination on the day

    We take over in the final weeks and run the day, so that you and your families are free to enjoy it.

    Destination weddings

    For couples from abroad: venues on the islands and the mainland, paperwork guidance, guest travel and stay — all in English.

    How we work

    From the first call to the last guest.

    1. 01

      Getting to know you

      A call or a meeting: the occasion, the guests, the date, the budget and what you dream of.

    2. 02

      Concept & mood board

      We come back with the idea of the event: aesthetics, palette, atmosphere and venue options.

    3. 03

      Proposal & budget

      A clear written proposal with every cost, so you decide calmly and with no surprises.

    4. 04

      Production

      Suppliers booked, design finalised, run sheet written — and regular updates for you.

    5. 05

      The day itself

      We are there from set-up to the end, directing every moment, so you only welcome your guests.

    6. 06

      Afterwards

      Supplier payments closed, photos and thank-you notes — and an event your guests will talk about.

    Questions

    What people ask us.

    Where do you organise events?

    We are based in Athens and organise events all over Greece — on the Aegean and Ionian islands, in the Peloponnese, in Thessaloniki and wherever you need us.

    How far in advance should we contact you?

    For weddings and large corporate events, ideally 6 to 12 months ahead, to secure the best venues and suppliers. For smaller celebrations and corporate dinners a few weeks are usually enough — always ask, even for something sooner.

    How is the cost calculated?

    Every event is different. After our first conversation we send a written proposal with a detailed budget: our fee for design and coordination and, separately, the cost of each supplier — so you know from the start where every euro goes.

    Do you work with companies and issue invoices?

    Yes. Corporate events are our core expertise — conferences, galas, award nights, launches and incentives — with invoicing, a clear agreement and one point of contact for your company.

    Can you find the right venue for us?

    Of course. Based on the number of guests, your style and your budget we suggest selected venues — mansions, hotels, villas, estates, rooftops, galleries — and arrange the visits.

    Do you plan destination weddings for couples from abroad?

    Yes. We take care of the venue, design, suppliers, transfers and guest accommodation, and guide you through the paperwork. We work in English as well as Greek.

    How do we start?

    Fill in the form of interest or send us a WhatsApp message. We reply within one working day and arrange a first meeting — in person or online.
